note: Minimal loader test vector for Darwin 24.6.0 / build 24H32 / GreenSardine bit. One GL table, one real 15.8.1 page image, one real site at page offset 0x160.

provenance.note: This is a loader/format test vector, not deployment data. The page image and find/replace bytes are real 15.8.1 master bytes; nothing is invented. The single site uses the real dual-quad replace bytes 83 C8 01 (master skip=1, count=1).
